# Standard

This folder contains the specific clinical quality targets and benchmarks established for the diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of patients with atrial fibrillation in the Danish healthcare system. Defined and tracked by the AFDK under the RKKP umbrella, these standards serve as the definitive measures of good clinical practice, setting minimum compliance rates for interventions like anticoagulation and echocardiography, as well as maximum acceptable incidence rates for severe outcomes like ischemic stroke and intracranial bleeding.

## Pages

- [[standard|Standard]] — Outlines the numerical thresholds and compliance targets for the eight primary clinical indicators governing atrial fibrillation care, including treatment wait times, long-term medication adherence, and patient education.
